title: Tile a matmul to cut measured DRAM transactions (real CUDA-C)
info: Real CUDA-C kernel parsed by arena.cuda_c and executed on arena.cuda_sim.GPU.
The simulator is 1D-launch only, so a 2x2 grid of 16x16 blocks is flattened into grid=4, block=256 and the kernel recovers 2D tile coordinates from threadIdx.x/blockIdx.x itself.
transaction_ratio is the measured global-memory transaction count divided by an untiled baseline the grader measures with its own internal (non-learner) 2D kernel on the same simulator.
